protocol_type: Register-mapped UART chip on a parallel host bus (CPU side); async serial framing on the wire side. No opcode/command set.

control_strobes: RD / RD (read; either active edge works)
WR / WR (write; either active edge works)
host_bus_interface.address_strobe: ADS (latches A0-A2 + CS0-CS2 on positive edge if used; tie LOW if not needed)
host_bus_interface.buffer_disable_output: DDIS (LOW during CPU reads from UART)

rows: RBR (R) / THR (W) — Receiver Buffer / Transmitter Holding
IIR (R) / FCR (W) — Interrupt Identification / FIFO Control

channels_serial_side.name: SIN
channels_serial_side.description: Serial data input from peripheral/modem. Idle HIGH.

channels_serial_side.name: SOUT
channels_serial_side.description: Serial data output to peripheral/modem. Idle HIGH.

channels_serial_side.name: CTS
channels_serial_side.description: Clear to Send (active LOW); modem status only — does not gate transmitter.

channels_serial_side.name: RTS
channels_serial_side.description: Request to Send (active LOW); MCR bit 1.

channels_serial_side.name: DSR
channels_serial_side.description: Data Set Ready (active LOW); modem status.

channels_serial_side.name: DTR
channels_serial_side.description: Data Terminal Ready (active LOW); MCR bit 0.

channels_serial_side.name: DCD
channels_serial_side.description: Data Carrier Detect (active LOW); modem status.

valid_ready_handshake_rules: There is no per-byte ACK or VALID/READY handshake on the serial wire — UART is asynchronous with frame-level start/stop framing.
Host-bus side uses RD/WR strobes with stable A0-A2 + CS0-CS2.
Hardware flow control (when used): RTS asserted = UART ready to receive; CTS asserted = modem ready to receive. CTS does NOT gate transmitter directly — software interprets MSR.CTS.

frame_format.parity_bit: Optional; even / odd / stick (mark or space).
frame_format.stop_bits: 1, 1.5 (5-bit char only), or 2 bits, always HIGH.
